items.title: Noodlophile Stealer Hides Behind Bogus Copyright Complaints
items.description: Noodlophile is targeting enterprises in spear-phishing attacks using copyright claims as phishing lures.

items.title: Noodlophile Malware Campaign Expands Global Reach with Copyright Phishing Lures
items.description: The threat actors behind the Noodlophile malware are leveraging spear-phishing emails and updated delivery mechanisms to deploy the information stealer in attacks aimed at enterprises located in the U.S., Europe, Baltic countries, and the Asia-Pacific (APAC) region. items.title: ERMAC Android malware source code leak exposes banking trojan infrastructure
